Question
========
Why do many funding organizations require researchers to submit a DMP?

Answerlist
----------
* To reduce the number of research projects
* To ensure transparency and responsible data stewardship
* To combat scientific misconduct early on
* To ensure reusability and long-term preservation of research data


Solution
========
Many funding organizations require a DMP to ensure transparency and responsible data stewardship.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
